title: Look Up!
summary: Birds and bats, kites and planes: a rhyming book that invites you to lift your head and discover the world above. On every page, look for the one that's different from all the rest.
pages:
Birds fly in the morning sky,
hungry, looking for a treat.
Find the one that's already caught
a worm that's yummy to eat!

Butterflies of every color
flutter among the flowers.
But one of them stands out from the rest,
all one color. Can you find it? Use your powers!

A merry gang of kites
bounces across the sky.
But one is a little different from the rest.
Can you find it? Open your eyes!

Squares, big and small,
you can see here and there.
But one window grille is different.
Where is it? Where, oh where?

Search among the green leaves
of the big old tree.
On one branch there's a spot of color.
Where is it? Here, maybe?

Airplanes fly across the sky
and leave a straight trail behind with flair.
But one of them is a little odd,
and its trail is curly, like hair.

A row of chattering birds
sits up high. Do you see?
But one of them loves quiet.
Which one? Tell me!

A flock of white clouds
shines on a hot summer day.
But one decided to make it rain,
and doesn't care what the others say.

The long day is over now,
and night has fallen on the town.
Of all the streetlights,
find one shining like the sun looking down.

When the sun is out, bats sleep,
and at night they wake to fly.
Can you find the different one,
still asleep while the others go by?

In space there are many planets,
shining and full of light.
Find the one that's special,
with a ring around it, round and tight.
